summary: Nexera Technologies filed a Form 6-K announcing a 1-for-11 reverse share split effective July 31, 2026, to regain compliance with Nasdaq listing requirements. The reverse split consolidates 11 ordinary shares into one, reducing outstanding shares from 6,132,100 to approximately 557,464. No fractional shares will be issued; fractional shares are rounded up at the DTC participant level. The authorized capital remains unchanged. Exercise prices of outstanding Series A, June 2026 PIPE, and June 2026 Note warrants were adjusted to $0.372944 pre-split. The new CUSIP is M61472 169. This is a routine capital structure adjustment, not a special situation. No deal terms apply.
